# csi-common golden fixtures

Generated by the originating project's own code at commit `15ea0c51` with `golden-generator/` (see its README for the exact commands). Do not edit by hand; regenerate.

| path | content |
|---|---|
| `volume_ids.tsv` | `ok` ids minted by the originating `VolumeId`/`SnapshotId` with the filesystem uuid and subtree each names, and `bad` ids it refuses |
| `class_cases.json` | StorageClass parameter maps |
| `default_prefix.txt` | the originating default bucket prefix (an application constant; passed to `ClassParams::parse`) |
| `class_params.tsv` | per case: the `Debug` of the parse result plus pool/dedicated prefixes and shard routing |

`cargo test -p replicix-csi-common --test golden` is origin -> replicix; `cargo run -p replicix-csi-common --example golden_out -- <outdir>` and `golden-gen verify <outdir>` is replicix -> origin.
